g.text: Demo tier critical flow — a recruiter's first query after days idle
ACCEPTED DESIGN · ADR-0010 amendment, 0013 amendment, 0014, 0015 · the warm-up overlaps the cold start with typing; SSE carries progress only, never unverified text
COLD-START BUDGET · first query after more than 24 h idle (estimates; S10-T10 records the real numbers)
the warm-up runs when Turnstile passes on the landing page, so search resume and FinBERT loading overlap with the visitor reading and typing.
SnapStart would remove most init time but bills its snapshot cache while idle (≈ $11.70/month for the worker), so it is rejected.
# claim (worker) · conditional write, the DynamoDB form of a fencing token
UpdateItem jobs[id] SET attempt = attempt + 1, state = running, lease_until = :t
IF state = queued OR (state = running AND lease_until < :now)
# later writes: IF state = running AND attempt = :mine -- fails ⇒ stale, discarded
: heartbeat every 15 s · stream ends at 5 min · reconnect replays from DynamoDB
